// diagnostic

E3306

`{module}` is not available for target `{target}`.

What

`{module}` is not available for target `{target}`.

Why

The browser Web backend has no native Wasmtime host-import boundary for `core.plugin`; plugin authority and component imports must stay on a native or server host. A `jet build` or `jet run` run reports this target-support diagnostic.

Fix

Build for a native target or `wasm32-wasip2`, or move plugin work behind a native/server boundary.
